fact: On 28 February 2024 the President activated at Pointe-Noire the Congo's connection to the 2Africa cable, and the government described the ARPCE data centre as connected to the two submarine cables, WACS and 2Africa, on two backbones.
title: Economie numérique : Denis Sassou N'Guesso connecte le Congo au câble 2Africa
publisher: Gouvernement de la République du Congo
